facts.fact: Universal Ads says its network includes 20+ publisher partners.
facts.quote: across its network of 20+ publisher partners while continuing to build and scale

facts.fact: Universal Ads says that upon completion of Comcast's planned separation, it will move to the NBCUniversal Media Group, reporting to Matt Strauss, Chairman of NBCUniversal Media.
facts.quote: Upon completion of the separation, Universal Ads will move to the NBCUniversal Media Group, reporting to Matt Strauss, Chairman of NBCUniversal Media.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says Comcast announced earlier in 2026 a plan to separate Comcast and NBCUniversal into two publicly traded companies.
facts.quote: Earlier this year, Comcast announced its plan to separate Comcast and NBCUniversal into two publicly traded companies.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says NBCUniversal Advertising, Sky Media, and Comcast Advertising will remain clients of Universal Ads after the separation.
facts.quote: NBCUniversal Advertising, Sky Media, and Comcast Advertising will remain clients of Universal Ads, managed the exact same way as today.

facts.fact: Universal Ads' blog post announcing the NBCUniversal move is dated October 26, 2026.
